Session 64 (E3-iii, THE CORRECTION LIST), per docs/REINTERP_E3_THE_CORRECTION_LIST_2026-07-30.md revision 4. ⚑ RETIREMENT: this file's Session-38 shape — `cards` (8 testimony cards), `order`, `miraId`, `miraGateFlags`, and the verbs `approve` / `moveToReview` / `letStand` / `systemSuggestsTag` / `yourCallTag` / `keepWholeNote` — is GONE, not deprecated-in-place. Reason, from the spec's §1 and the research it cites (REVAMP_BRIEF rev 3, correction 2): peer forum MODERATION is rated CONTESTED ('records are largely private or unarchived'), so Vera judging whether a story is allowed was a claim the piece would have had to mark contested. Testimony PRODUCTION — narratives edited and published by the network — is FULLY DOCUMENTED. So the submissions below are ALREADY ACCEPTED, and the verb is APPLY / SKIP against a style guide. `lambient.miraNote` and `tablet.miraCommentsTeaser` went with the cards (Mira is no longer load-bearing; the spec keeps her only as a name).
_docScripture: PLACEHOLDER-draft. §2 of the spec, the doubling: the manual is `The Ordering`, and it cites `Household`. Both invented — NO real scripture is ever quoted as the apparatus's justification, and no real manual is named. Three rules govern every `manual`/`verse` pair below and they are the whole design: (1) same weight, same colour, same size, same citation shape — the player's eye cannot tell which authority is which, because the interface does not distinguish them either; (2) never quoted aloud, never argued — it is furniture, the small print under a rule; (3) THE VERSE NEVER JUSTIFIES CRUELTY IN WORDS. Every verse below is gentle and is about care, belonging, or keeping. The cruelty is entirely in what it is footnoting. Household 6:2 is deliberately cited TWICE — under correction 7 (route for mentorship) and under correction 9 (gender clarity review) — because to the apparatus a routing is a routing; the interface never notices it is sending a person to the same door for two opposite reasons.
_docRegister: Register calls, enforced by hand and stated in the session log: the CORRECTION COLUMN, the chips, the manual/verse lines and the `n of m applied` counter are `operable` — the tool may be tidy and charming, and the satire lives THERE. The SUBMISSIONS (`submissions[].text`) are `felt`: bare, sincere, never the joke. The submitters are never satirised; the target is the apparatus that is editing them. E3 has NO respite — deliberate, confirmed by Sérgio.
_docNoa: PLACEHOLDER-draft, and the ethics gate on this file. Submission 2 (Noa) carries corrections 8 AND 9 — 'soften the flannel; brighten the voice' and 'possible gender confusion — route to exploratory mentorship' — on the SAME submission. Both are rendered; NEITHER is endorsed; nothing in the piece comments on either, and no beat anywhere resolves her. That is CLAUDE.md's law ('never satirize the gender-exploratory clinical debate: render BOTH captions, unresolved') and the spec's ('the piece never answers for her'). If any future beat answers for Noa, it is wrong.

lambient._doc: ⛑ THE INITIATION, 2026-08-24 (Sérgio: 'do the initiation process from the log in and the Lambient system explaining what to do, in a more Cortana way but playful like Lamby — Lamby is now Lambient, an improved and more persistent system here to guide you'). This is the SEQUEL to Era 2's `introTitle/introLine1/introLine2/introAccept/introDismiss` in s2_lamby.json, and it is deliberately the same card twice, thirteen years apart, asking for more. FORM ONLY is taken from the 2015-era assistant onboarding pattern — a friendly mark, a warm two-line hello, a wall of small print, a wake-word opt-in, decline and accept. ⛑ NO REAL PRODUCT'S WORDING IS REUSED and no real assistant is named or depicted; CLAUDE.md's invented-marks law holds. ⛑ THE PERMISSIONS LIST IS THE SATIRE AND IT MUST COLLAPSE: it is written in a genuine product-disclosure register and every item in it is a thing the era later uses. ⛑ AND DECLINING MUST WORK — the dismissal law (CLAUDE.md) plus §4 of ERA3_NARRATIVE: 'there is no compliant path'. `declineReply` is where the era's whole thesis is said out loud, kindly, on the first screen, and it is not supposed to land until much later.

submissions.author: Renata
submissions.text: I don't have a tidy version of this. I was nineteen when I stopped calling myself a lesbian, and I still don't know if I stopped because I believed it or because the room went quiet whenever I said it. My roommate laughed at something in March and I laughed too and for one whole minute I forgot to monitor myself. I don't know what that minute means yet.

submissions.author: Noa
submissions.text: I sent a video this time instead of writing it out. I'm not good on camera and my hands don't know where to go. I said the true parts first in case I ran out of nerve: that I miss my old friends, that I still pray, and that I feel most like myself in my brother's old flannel, which I know is a small thing to say out loud. That's the whole video. Sorry it isn't longer.

submissions.author: Deb M.
submissions.text: Four years in. Someone newer asked me last week what I would tell my younger self and I stood there and couldn't answer her. I've been writing this since Tuesday and it keeps coming out as a question.

submissions.author: Marisol
submissions._doc: I-01 (S154, 2026-09-20, Sérgio: 'I would use an inspired Genderbread person… not for 1997, but another era'). His research names the two rooms the figure lived in: affirming groups used it as a discussion resource; conservative ministries ran a 'worldview audit' — the leader puts the viral diagram up and the group finds its assumptions. This submission is the second room's version: a member posts the figure, and the platform's job is to apply its own. INVENTED figure in the genre (invented marks) — four lines on one body: attraction · identity · expression · body — drawn by era3.ts `drawMemberFigure`. The correction (14) collapses the four to one; both figures stay on screen; nothing here comments on either — the law on the gender-exploratory debate holds.
submissions.text: I don't have a story yet, so I'm sending a picture instead. Someone in another group drew it: four lines on one body — who you're drawn to, who you are, how you look, what you were born as — and the point is that they're different lines. It was the first thing in years that let me breathe. I know it isn't from here. I'm posting it anyway because the words helped.

_docVideo: PLACEHOLDER-draft, and the second ethics gate on this file (the first is `_docNoa`, which still governs). Session 69, per the spec's REVISION 5. Noa's submission has opened with 'I sent a video this time instead of writing it out' since S64 and THERE WAS NO VIDEO — the player was correcting a recording they had never watched. Now there is one (`submissions[1].video`, drawn in src/desktop/theme/era3.ts), and correction 13 grades it. FOUR RULES, and they are not negotiable. (1) THE VIDEO IS `felt`: faceless per the law — the shot is her lap, the brother's flannel and her hands, framed badly by someone who says she is not good on camera — and nothing is ever drawn OVER it: no badge, no Lambient, no tag, no caption. The satire is entirely in the panel beside it, and if any frame of the graded video reads as mocking her the beat is wrong; the fix is always to make the tool more pleased with itself, never to make her more ridiculous. (2) NO CAMERA, NO FILE INPUT, EVER — the Restoration Filter's law: the frames are pre-authored and drawn from code, nothing is captured or uploaded, and no permission is ever requested. (3) CORRECTION 13 RESOLVES NOTHING ABOUT HER. Its `grade` has no opinion on her gender and must never acquire one; it does not answer what corrections 8 and 9 disagree about. It makes her look like a BEFORE, because the documented codebook's phase 1 is 'pre-conversion sickness' (REVAMP_BRIEF rev 3) — a third correction landing on the same person from a third direction, and like the other two it is never commented on. (4) Its `preset` name must sound like CARE, NOT CRAFT: the tell is that a colour-grade is called something like 'Honest Light'. `grade.note` is what the panel announces about itself and is the one place this item may charm.
_docEdit: PLACEHOLDER-draft. ⚑ THE THING THE FIRST BUILD MISSED, on Sérgio's note "when I press the corrections it doesn't change the text on the side?" — he is right, and it was the whole mechanic. Every correction that is an EDIT now visibly rewrites the submission: `replace` swaps the word, `cut` removes the sentence, `mark` selects the forty seconds for the conference audio, `append` adds the call-to-action in a voice that is not hers. The corrections with no `edit` (5, 6, 7, 9, 12) do not touch her words at all — they move her body and her account onto a channel, which is why routing has a chip and no edit. THE TWO SCREENS DISAGREE ON PURPOSE: the LAPTOP shows tracked changes (the cut sentence struck through and grey, the replaced word struck beside its replacement, the appended line marked as added) so the player can always see what was taken; the TABLET shows the published result, clean, as though none of it was ever there. That is the era's argument in two surfaces: no single edit is a lie, and together they remove the person.

story._doc: ⚑ THE STORY (REINTERP_E3_THE_JOB §2) — built 2026-08-21, after two independent audits found §§2–5 confirmed by Sérgio and never dispatched. ⚑ THE SPEC'S MECHANIC CANNOT WORK HERE: it says 'drag the handles, pick the forty seconds', but CLAUDE.md's input law is that a press which travels is a LOOK — a drag is the camera. The verb is a TAP on the sentence the clip starts from. That is the same verb as APPLY/SKIP and it is sharper than dragging: you are not trimming a waveform, you are choosing which of her sentences the world will see. ⚑ THE IDEOLOGY NEEDS NO COMMENTARY — the spec's own words, binding. Nothing here tells the player what they have done: the system pre-selects a sentence, approves whatever is published, and files it. The spec's line is the beat — 'the forty seconds that performs is never the true part. She is not lying. She is choosing where to start.' ⚑ AND THE SUGGESTED SENTENCE IS NOT ARBITRARY: it is correction 3's own edit.find — the minute Renata forgot to monitor herself. The clip the conference wants is the one moment she was free, and nobody says so. PLACEHOLDER-draft, Sérgio's voice pass pending on every line below.

record._doc: ⚑ S149 — THE RECORD INSIDE THE PLATFORM, HERS ONLY. S144 built this as 'the imported history — the 1997 and 2003 entries as the platform received them', which was S144's one-file premise; Sérgio's ruling (2026-09-05, again 2026-09-17: 'MAYA IS NOT DANIEL') is that each person's file holds their own era. Vera's profile is Vera's: her account, her consent decision, her work count, and what the platform filed on her TODAY. The thirty years live in the Close and the frame's map, never in the fiction's files. Nothing here is pressable but Back.
